fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on enforcement against marble-board gambling devices and other gambling activity, criticism of county purchasing practices, and Miami municipal politics (including debate over an advisory role for Sewell on a publicity board). Reports and commentary address Southern Bell telephone rate disputes and valuations, and a shooting of a Tribune reporter with subsequent hospitalization at Jackson Memorial Hospital. Regular columns and community items appear alongside advertisements and notices, including promotion of a July 4 outing for children.
